contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ VICTORIAE LAETAE PRINC PERP ; D/ [...] MAX AVG

A copper-alloy nummus of Constantine I, AD306-337. AD319-320, (Reece period 16). Reverse legend reads VICTORIAE LAETAE PRINC PERP. Reverse shows Two Victories holding shield inscribed VOT/PR over altar. Mint unknown. Obverse shows [?Helmeted] and cuirassed bust right. Obverse legend reads [...] MAX AVG. Reverse fields and exergue read: / //[...]. Condition is fine, die axis is 6 o'clock, weight…
